anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Male, perfect, unblemished sheep; roast with fire, not raw, not boiled.
Blood on the doorposts; the destroyer does not touch them.

choices.why: Exodus's destroying one; Origen keeps the participle.

pass_a_gloss: Since the Hebrew people then come out of Egypt, the law is reasonably given them of this feast thus by houses, so that each, taking a male sheep perfect unblemished, may sacrifice and toward evening eat it roasted with fire, neither raw nor boiled in water, so that the destroyer of the Egyptians' firstborn may not touch them, seeing their doorposts anointed with the blood.
pass_b_english: Since the people [of the] Hebrews then come out [of Egypt, the] law is [reasonably] given them for this feast in this way, household by household: so that each, taking a male sheep, perfect [and] unblemished, may sacrifice [it and] toward evening eat [it roasted] with fire, neither raw nor [boiled] in water — so that the destroyer of the firstborn of the Egyptians may not touch them, seeing the posts of their doors anointed with the blood.
source_text: Ἐπεὶ ὁ λαὸ[ς ὁ Ἑ]βραίων τότ[ε] ἐξ[έρ]χετ[α]ι τ[ὴν Αἴγυπτον, ὁ] νόμο[ς] ε[ἰκότως αὐ]τοῖς τα[ύτ]ης τῆς ἑορτῆς δίδοται οὕ[τ]ως κα[τ]’ ο[ἴ]κους, ὅπως ἕκαστοι πρόβατο[ν] ἄρσεν τέλει[ον ἄ]μωμον λαβό[ντ]ες θύσω[σιν καὶ π]ρὸς ἑ[σ]π[έ]ραν φάγω[σιν ὀπτὸ]ν πυ[ρὶ] οὔτε ὠμὸν οὔ[τε ἡ]ψημένον ἐν ὕδατι ἵν’ οὕ[τως] ὁ ὀλεθρεύων τὰ πρωτότ[οκα τ]ῶν Αἰγυπτίων μὴ θίγῃ αὐτῶν τὰς φλιὰς τῶν θυρῶν αὐτῶν ὁρῶν τῷ αἵματι κεχρισμένας.
